column1: # Model Id (the I/O List Part No. without spaces; a head without a Part No. is keyed by its Manufacturer when a row carries that)
column3: Catalog Item (SYCON.net device catalog: PROFINET IO > Master | Slave | Gateway / Stand-Alone Slave > this item; a bracketed suffix names the DAP the catalog info pane cites when several entries share the name and the GSDML - e.g. PN/PN Coupler X2 [DAP X2 V4.2])
column4: Modules (iolist = the I/O List cards by slot tag are plugged | iolink-ports = the IO-Link ports X01..X08 configured from the connector rows | scalance-pnio = a SCALANCE switch's PN-IO interface parameters | fixed = the Fixed Modules column is plugged | default = the catalog defaults stay)
column5: GSDML (the file whose catalog entry is taken - the catalog lists one entry per version)
column7: Symbolic Name (the netDevice label before [type]<station> is nnn[_Custom Description]: nnn the node number = the IP's last octet in three digits; the rule gives the description - default = none (the label is nnn alone) | fld = the I/O List functional unit + the location's first segment (088_=TRIB-CA01; =TRIB-MA01 of -MA01-AEC1) | variable = the description's variable part (a coupler's 'SORTER (=TRIB) / INDUCTION LINES GR1 (=TRIB-AEC01)') | description = the Description Module)
column8: Fixed Modules (policy fixed: the module texts plugged in slot order; '|' separated; N[text] = N modules of the bracketed text verbatim - or one list per connector of the I/O List's Connector column; ';' separated: 'X2: 4[*OUT 128 Byte] | 4[*IN 128 Byte]; X1: 4[*IN 128 Byte] | 4[*OUT 128 Byte]'; the Catalog Item column takes the same per-connector form)
column9: DAP Parameters (the device's own submodule - slot 0 subslot 1 - set through its Parameter dataset: index=value | ... with the index counted from 0 within the first record; record:<idx>=<bytes> entries are the read-back oracle only)

column6: Hilscher cifX 80 compact PCI card = the PROFINET IO controller of the sorter PC (the second card of a redundant pair is skipped)

column3: X2: PN/PN Coupler X2 [DAP X2 V4.2]; X1: PN/PN Coupler X1 [DAP X1 V4.2]
column6: PN/PN coupler - one part number with two sides - the I/O List's Connector column picks the catalog entry and the modules: X2 faces the sorter network (the five same-named X2 entries are the DAPs V1.0 / V2.2 / V3.0 / V4.0 / V4.2 of this one GSDML - V4.2 is the 6ES7 158-3AD10 hardware - user 2026-10-23) and X1 is the other PLC's side (its DAP name by symmetry with X2 - not yet dragged on the VM) - the modules (user 2026-10-26): 4 x *OUT 128 Byte then 4 x *IN 128 Byte on X2 (512 bytes each way) and the mirror on X1 - N[text] = N modules of the bracketed text verbatim
column8: X2: 4[*OUT 128 Byte] | 4[*IN 128 Byte]; X1: 4[*IN 128 Byte] | 4[*OUT 128 Byte]
